- [IRET.1.13] **Rule-fire events for recording
  integration.** Before and after each activation fires,
  the engine emits `DS_EV_RULE_FIRE_BEGIN` /
  `DS_EV_RULE_FIRE_END` stream events carrying the **rule
  name** (`recorder.c::ds_recorder_emit_rule_fire_{begin,end}`;
  the event payload is `{ const char *rule_name; }`). The
  recorder's before/after machinery consumes these — there
  is no separate firing-token hook.
